title: Living in the Tension
verse: Joshua said to the family of Joseph—to both Ephraim and Manasseh: “You have many people and great military strength. You will not have just one tribal allotment.
observation: They came to Joshua and said they were thankful for what they had, but it wasn’t enough. They were thankful but wanted more. This is like life for most of us. We are thankful for what we have but always needing more. Joshua was willing to give them more but it also meant they were going to have to take it over as well. This means that God is often willing to give us more but when more is given, responsibility increases. Be sure you count the cost before asking for more.
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for giving us the wisdom to always count the cost before moving forward.
